title: Version a Cross-Robot Dataset Manifest
summary: A mixed dataset needs an identity that includes its versions, embodiments and calibration.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Registry IDs, semantic versions and byte-content hashes have no physical units; calibration hashes identify externally pinned physical conventions.

physical_contract.axes: bounded record list -> canonical JSON string and SHA256 string
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: An immutable snapshot, not a mutable latest-version pointer; no wall clock enters the digest.
physical_contract.batching: bounded record list -> canonical JSON string and SHA256 string

provenance.authoring_notes: Original lineage exercise motivated by cross-robot dataset reproducibility. Hashes are caller-supplied commitments, not proof that actual remote bytes match them.
